propositions: A crash during Jira issue creation leaves a keyless-pending binding entry (jira_key=None), which recover_pending's index-dependent search misses due to Lucene lag and incorrectly unbinds
create_one's dedup search also misses the unindexed issue for the same Lucene lag reason and creates a duplicate, even if recover_pending is fixed to not unbind
The create gate at outbound_differ gates on get_jira_key(local_id) is None, which remains true for keyless-pending entries, so it cannot suppress a create when a pending binding exists
Single negative searches must not unbind: unbinding requires both search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeding index-lag grace window (3600s) to corroborate absence
The create must be deferred (not issued) at create_one when a keyless-pending binding for that local_id exists and is younger than the grace window, using the already-present is_pending accessor
